PreritRoshan.name: Prerit Roshan
PreritRoshan.message: At Elysium Aerotech, we are engineering the next evolution of intelligent aviation. Our mission goes beyond building autonomous systems — we are redefining how aerial platforms think, adapt, and perform. By integrating advanced AI, precision engineering, and future-ready design philosophies, we aim to create systems that are not only smarter and safer, but fundamentally transformative. Every innovation we develop reflects our commitment to excellence, technological leadership, and advancing human capability through autonomous flight.
PreritRoshan.bio: Visionary technologist driving innovation at the intersection of aerospace and intelligence systems.
PreritRoshan.expertise: Autonomous Systems Architecture, Artificial Intelligence Integration, Advanced Systems Design

RaghavJindal.name: Raghav Jindal
RaghavJindal.message: Operational excellence and financial discipline form the backbone of Elysium Aerotech’s growth. Our approach focuses on building scalable systems, ensuring fiscal responsibility, and enabling sustainable expansion without compromising innovation. By aligning strategic planning with execution excellence, we create a foundation that allows bold ideas to thrive while maintaining long-term stability and investor confidence.
RaghavJindal.bio: Strategic and operational leader driving sustainable growth and execution excellence.
RaghavJindal.expertise: Operations Management, Strategic Planning, Financial Leadership

DevGarg.name: Dev Garg
DevGarg.message: In a world driven by data and connectivity, resilience and security define success. At Elysium Aerotech, our digital infrastructure is built with enterprise-grade architecture, redundancy, and security at its core. From cloud-native systems to distributed computing frameworks, every layer is designed for reliability, scalability, and protection. Our commitment ensures that every operation, every dataset, and every mission remains secure and dependable.
DevGarg.bio: Technology leader focused on secure, scalable, and resilient digital infrastructure.
DevGarg.expertise: Information Security, Cloud Architecture, Infrastructure Engineering

NeelrishamSingh.name: Neelrisham Singh
NeelrishamSingh.message: People are the driving force behind innovation. At Elysium Aerotech, we cultivate a culture built on learning, ownership, and excellence. By empowering individuals and fostering collaboration across disciplines, we create teams capable of solving complex challenges in autonomous aviation. Our focus is not just on building technology, but on building the people who shape the future of aerospace.
NeelrishamSingh.bio: People-first leader shaping culture, talent, and organizational excellence.
NeelrishamSingh.expertise: Talent Development, Organizational Culture, Human Capital Strategy
